blocks_element.repere: Texte · What does Oliva Dorado mean?
Paragraphe · Oliva Dorado translates from Spanish to
blocks_element.text: Oliva Dorado translates from Spanish to “Golden Olive.” The name is inspired by the saying, “Olive Oil is the Liquid Gold of the Mediterranean.” This phrase traces back thousands of years to ancient Greece, where olive oil was prized not just as food, but as a symbol of wealth, vitality, and divine favor. Our name pays tribute to that legacy, reflecting the enduring elegance and value of true extra virgin olive oil.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · What makes this olive oil different from
blocks_element.text: What makes this olive oil different from what I can get in stores?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Oliva Dorado is made from early-harvest
blocks_element.text: Oliva Dorado is made from early-harvest olives grown on our single family farm in Spain. The olives are cold-pressed within hours of harvesting and bottled in dark glass to help protect flavor and nutrients. We focus on quality, freshness, and full traceability from harvest to bottle.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Does it actually taste better?
Paragraphe · Yes. Because our olives are harvested ea
blocks_element.text: Yes. Because our olives are harvested early and pressed fresh, the oil has a brighter, more complex flavor. Overall, Oliva Dorado is a lighter olive oil with fruity, buttery notes and a clean, smooth finish. Once you try this kind of fresh, early-harvest extra virgin olive oil, it’s hard to go back to anything else.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Is it good for cooking or just drizzling
blocks_element.text: Is it good for cooking or just drizzling?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · You can absolutely cook with it. High-qu
blocks_element.text: You can absolutely cook with it. High-quality extra virgin olive oil like ours is a great everyday option. Because it is rich in polyphenols, it may be more stable when used with heat compared to lower-grade oils. It’s ideal for dipping, drizzling, salad dressings, marinades, sautéing, roasting, and even baking.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · How long will it stay fresh?
blocks_element.text: How long will it stay fresh?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Our olive oil is best enjoyed within 12
blocks_element.text: Our olive oil is best enjoyed within 12 to 24 months of harvest. To help preserve its freshness, store it in a cool, dark place, away from heat, and always keep the cap tightly closed. We use dark glass bottles to help protect the oil from light and ship quickly after bottling. You’ll always receive oil from the most recent harvest. We’re currently shipping from our 2025-2026 harvest, which was harvested in October 2025.
